summary: The admitted v71 baseline stops because apply.js calls stumble_onto_mimic from use_whip without importing the already-ported helper. The fix adds that import; the baseline evaluation below remains the pre-fix measurement.

source.branch: When the wielded bullwhip targets a monster disguised with M_AP_TYPE, the hero lacks Protection from shape changers, and sensemon is false, apply.c:use_whip calls uhitm.c:stumble_onto_mimic(mtmp), sets do_snap false, then continues through force_attack/wakeup in source order. js/apply.js:use_whip already has the same condition and call but omits stumble_onto_mimic from its js/uhitm.js import list.
callers: C cmd.c:doapply -> apply.c:doapply BULLWHIP case -> apply.c:use_whip -> uhitm.c:stumble_onto_mimic; JS cmd.js apply command -> apply.js:doapply -> apply.js:use_whip -> uhitm.js:stumble_onto_mimic.
dependencies: The existing uhitm.c:stumble_onto_mimic port in js/uhitm.js is called; this task only repairs the missing apply.js import.

evidence: The admitted v71 baseline evaluation stops before any screen, RNG call, or cursor match with ReferenceError: stumble_onto_mimic is not defined.

The source-directed recipe selects a disguised small mimic with a wielded bullwhip, then applies the whip toward the C-observed mimic square; it records the target at (68,16), northwest of the hero at (69,17), and documents the earlier wrong-direction probe.

Read complete upstream apply.c:use_whip (2955-3271), including its BULLWHIP dispatch, mimic detection branch, call to stumble_onto_mimic, do_snap update, force_attack, wakeup, and return order. The matching JS branch calls the helper but its uhitm.js import list omits it.

After the import fix, scripts/scan-sessions.mjs replayed the admitted v71 recording with all 247 screens, RNG calls, and cursor positions matching through the full recording; the scan returned no error.
scripts/synthetic-range-evidence.mjs verified the production entry point through segment 0, step 246.
The focused apply/pole/whip test file passed all 9 tests, and npm run lint passed.
